0x100743D0.evidence: moves the iterator's current node (+0x14) to the next one in its chain (child list +0x10 or sibling list +8 by mode), skipping nodes not of the wanted kind (+8) or flags (+0x20 & +0x10 == +0xC), tracking nesting with g_resourceFindDepth; called by ResourceIter_FindFirst, _Start and _FindNext
